_usage: All icons: viewBox 0 0 16 16, fill none, stroke-linecap round, stroke-linejoin round. Stroke width 1.4 inside tinted tiles and tags, 1.6 on white chips, 1.5 for trust icons. Copy the path data exactly; do not substitute an icon library.

fitMeter._usage: Three bars, 4px wide, heights 6, 10, 14px, gap 2px, radius 1px, aligned to the bottom. Filled bars use graphite, empty bars stone-300.

logo._usage: Use kite-full.svg at 40px wide and above, kite-small.svg below. In lockups and app icons the mark is rotated -16deg. Wordmark: 'blackkite' lowercase, Figtree 600, letter-spacing -0.025em, with the 'kk' pair at -0.045em.
